prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of change remains thin, as each kind of change has only 1 test so far.
Sign-in hint (sign_in, hint) and sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) were helpful as both won their tests.
Finish copy changes (finish, copy) performed worse and hurt the finish rate.
No clear effect was seen for adoption, choose_path, finish (new_screen), and home changes.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too low for sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.6% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: -1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post Onboarding Desktop Pet Control Guide: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen right before final intro screen explaining desktop tray controls, hiding, and pet interaction. (why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on controlling/hiding/talking to pets after onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Companion Story Flow: Rebuild the initial story and path selection experience into an interactive story scroll layout highlighting companion roles. (why: choose_path has a very high mean duration of 514s and drop-off to 76.2%, indicating users stall on deciding their path.)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Progress Stage Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight stage with real-time rendering progress bars and desktop launch status. (why: Waiting step takes a mean 2336s (median 201s), and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Cloud Restore Hint: Add an explicit account recovery notice on sign_in reassuring users that logging in restores existing cloud pets. (why: 8 support emails (largest theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desk Pet Launch Readiness Notification: Enable desktop readiness notification toggle and system tray tips on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: Home waiting duration mean is 2336s, causing users to abandon or assume app installation stalled.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Trait Badges Showcase: Add companion personality and behavioral style badges on the pick_friend selection view. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and 89s median time due to hesitation during pet selection.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Mascot Welcome Banner: Add an interactive pet mascot welcome card and completion instructions to the home intro finish screen. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with high mean time (5815s) as users are unsure if onboarding completed.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Time Estimate Header: Add step counter and time estimate headers on choose_path screen. (why: choose_path has mean duration 514s and 76.2% conversion.)

scores.note: Finish step has high drop-off and 3 support tickets, but new screens require a full release and past tests show modest lift.
Interactive story rebuild is high effort with unproven history on choose_path changes.
Addressed by 3 support mails on waiting screen, but home redesigns have not shown clear positive patterns previously.
Strong evidence with 8 support mails, low implementation cost, and sign_in hints previously won their test.
Previous test for home wait_info yielded +0.0% lift despite high duration.
Adoption loses the most users (60.9% conversion), though evidence for trait badges specifically is limited.
Finish step copy/banner updates previously hurt finish completion rates.
Cheap config/copy change to address long time on choose_path, but lift expected to be minimal.
